last_action: OODA-15: 35-experiment parameter sweep. destructive_penalty 0.45->0.35, chiral 0.7->0.9, kuramoto_threshold 0.35->0.55. 10-run avg 0.0962->0.0850 (11.6% improvement).

blockers.phase_coherence: avg 0.739 (10% weight, structural tension with chiral_perturbation)

autoresearch.notes: 35 experiments run across 18 parameters. Key findings: (1) destructive_penalty=0.35 was the single biggest win — saved 6 signal memories (0.907->0.987), worth 0.008 fitness. (2) kuramoto_threshold=0.55 stabilizes xi_diversity by restricting Kuramoto coupling to only highly-similar pairs (>0.55 cosine similarity), reducing cross-cluster contamination and improving chiral perturbation effectiveness. Sweet spot at 0.55; 0.50 causes xi collapse, 0.65 also collapses. (3) chiral_perturbation=0.9 is optimal — 0.7 too weak, 0.8 too weak, 1.0-1.1 diminishing returns. (4) kuramoto_coupling=1.5 improves phase_coherence (0.774->0.821) but slightly hurts xi_diversity and occasionally drops hallucinations — net wash vs 0.8. (5) dream_cycles=2 dramatically boosts phase_coherence and xi_diversity but kills signal memories, even with penalty=0.25. (6) phase_coherence and xi_diversity are inversely correlated — fundamental tension between Kuramoto sync (phases align) and chiral perturbation (phases diverge). (7) bridge_links stuck at 0.833 (5/6 bridges) — no param change affects it. (8) dream_efficiency stuck at 0.876 — driven by strengthened=1210, links=427, pruned=230, structurally determined. (9) constructive_boost, interference_threshold, phase_spread, noise_floor, hallucination_amplitude all tested with no improvement. (10) Dead params confirmed: xi_repulsion_weight, decay_rate, default_frequency.

active_hypotheses.title: consciousness_phi_target must be near 0 for maximum score
active_hypotheses.notes: phi_target=0.0001 gives consciousness=0.999. Unchanged from OODA-14.

active_hypotheses.title: interference_threshold optimal at 0.10
active_hypotheses.notes: Tested 0.08 (worse signal, worse phase) and 0.12 (worse xi). 0.10 remains best.

active_hypotheses.title: Xi diversity variance dominated by stochastic Kuramoto clustering
active_hypotheses.notes: OODA-15: kuramoto_threshold=0.55 reduces variance by restricting which pairs couple. But xi still ranges 0.34-1.00 across 10 runs. Root cause is KuramotoSync producing different cluster assignments. Further improvement requires deterministic cluster assignment or seeded RNG in Kuramoto.

active_hypotheses.title: Dead params: xi_repulsion_weight, decay_rate, default_frequency
active_hypotheses.notes: xi_repulsion_weight still not wired. hallucination_amplitude IS now wired (verified in consolidation.rs lines 1007, 1127). Tested hall_amp=0.5 — no benefit.

active_hypotheses.title: destructive_penalty controls signal preservation via amplitude penalties
active_hypotheses.notes: OODA-15: penalty=0.35 saves 6 signals vs 0.45. penalty=0.30 starts losing noise (noise_removal drops to 0.9). Sweet spot: 0.35.

active_hypotheses.title: kuramoto_threshold=0.55 is a phase-transition boundary for xi_diversity
active_hypotheses.notes: OODA-15: threshold=0.50 gives avg xi=0.29, threshold=0.55 gives avg xi=0.67. Sharp cliff. 0.58 and 0.65 both worse. The threshold 0.55 restricts coupling to only truly similar pairs, allowing chiral perturbation to create diversity among weakly-coupled pairs.

active_hypotheses.title: phase_coherence and xi_diversity are structurally inversely correlated
active_hypotheses.notes: OODA-15: Across all 35 experiments, when phase_coherence is high in a run, xi_diversity tends to be low, and vice versa. This is fundamental: Kuramoto sync aligns phases (good for coherence) while chiral perturbation perturbs them (good for xi diversity). Both are applied sequentially. dream_cycles=2 maxes both (phase=0.97, xi=0.96) but kills signals.

next_experiment: Parameter optimization approaching diminishing returns. Remaining gains require structural changes: (1) Seed RNG in KuramotoSync::default() to make xi_diversity deterministic. (2) Apply chiral perturbation only to cross-cluster pairs (preserve within-cluster phase coherence). (3) Make dream_cycles=2 safe by exempting signal memories from second-pass pruning. (4) Wire xi_repulsion_weight to actual code. (5) Address bridge_links=0.833 stuck issue.
